name: codeguard
description: Cross-language code lint enforcement for AI coding assistants (ZCode, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi Code): Java, Rust, TypeScript, Python. PostToolUse hook auto-runs the native linter on every AI-written file and blocks on failure in strict mode.

description_i18n.en: Cross-language code lint enforcement. PostToolUse hook auto-runs the language-specific linter on every AI-written file; failed lint blocks further writes when strict_mode is on. Ships ready-to-go .pre-commit-config.yaml templates for Java/Rust/TypeScript/Python.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 跨语言代码规范强制门禁插件，专为 ZCode / Claude Code / Codex CLI / Kimi Code 等 AI 编程助手设计。PostToolUse 钩子在 AI 写完文件后自动跑对应语言 linter；严格模式下失败会阻塞 AI 继续。内含可直接接入的 .pre-commit-config.yaml 模板。

enabled_languages.title: 启用的语言
enabled_languages.description: 逗号分隔，支持 java/rust/typescript/python，留空 (auto) 自动检测项目语言

strict_mode.title: 严格模式
strict_mode.description: 启用后 PostToolUse 钩子会在 linter 失败时返回非 0 退出码，AI 必须修复后才能继续

auto_fix_on_save.title: 自动修复
auto_fix_on_save.description: linter 失败时先尝试自动修复（spotless:apply / cargo fmt / eslint --fix / ruff --fix），再重跑 lint

lint_timeout_seconds.title: 单次 linter 超时（秒）
lint_timeout_seconds.description: PostToolUse 钩子每次调 linter 的最长等待时间
